title: kOA Correlation Context
description: Versioned correlation context shared by requests, component-local receipts, events, and evidence in one workflow. Correlation links records without merging component ownership, data authority, or decision authority.
$comment: The semantic validator must ensure that all records in one workflow reuse the same correlation_id, that causation_id identifies the immediate declared cause when supplied, and that identifiers are never reused to imply shared authority.

semantic_rules: one workflow uses one correlation identifier
causation never substitutes for idempotency or authorization

correlation_id.description: Stable identifier shared by all records belonging to one declared workflow.

request_id.description: Stable identity of the originating or currently handled request when one exists.

causation_id.description: Stable identity of the immediate declared request, event, receipt, or transition that caused this record.
